description: I'm Harshith Raja, a first-year AI/ML student at KPR Institute of Engineering and Technology. I love building practical, problem-solving projects, from healthcare platforms and IoT safety systems to ML-powered apps. I've taken part in Smart India Hackathon, ideathons, and project expos, and I'm now working toward an ML internship while sharpening my skills in Python, full-stack development, and machine learning.
